blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. HLSCOPE is a permissioned Securitize fund share, but KYC-only primary access is not the basis for Yes. All five catalogued native contracts were measured: Polygon totalSupply 3,131,897,107 raw units at block 95790138 (2026-10-19T06:15:54Z), Ethereum 148,249,194 at block 26224768 (06:15:47Z), Optimism 0 at block 158395888 (06:15:53Z), Plume 16,267,368 at block 100304388 (06:15:54Z), and Tron 20,008,680 in an adjacent head observation at approximately 06:15:56Z (not a pinned eth_call). The 3,316,422,349-unit gross native-supply denominator places Polygon at approximately 94.436%, with each other deployment below 10%; no separately reconciled circulating or bridge-lock-adjusted denominator is available from census. On material Polygon token 0x4c5ca366e26409845624e29b62c388a06961a792, implementation 0x5e98857d4bd2b3569a87c0f226e2c961aae02e0b is verified DSToken. At the pinned Polygon block, owner 0x59c1eacec450c57dcb9b8725d0f96635c2b676ee held MASTER role 1 in trust service 0xe55ef49e8c205bd4b640f30beb70e00fe1b877ee. The current implementation authorizes MASTER to seize arbitrary holder balances with seize(from,to,value,reason) and burn selected holders via burn(who,value,reason), without allowance. transfer/transferFrom additionally call issuer-controlled compliance validation. Those active material holder-targeted controls establish Yes independently of fund-reserve custody. Ethereum, Optimism, Plume and Tron issuer-native controls are disclosed as sub-threshold rather than verdict-setting. There is no tracked parent; the declared reserve book is 100% the custodial SCOPE feeder/Main Fund claim. No historical freeze event is asserted.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: HLSCOPE has five reviewed issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Plume, and Tron. Official issuer announcements describe Wormhole-powered multichain interoperability, but no HLSCOPE-specific adapter, NTT manager/transceiver, bridge controller, peer/DVN configuration, rate limit, or burn/lock accounting has been identified in reviewed primary sources. The profile therefore retains the conservative external-lock-mint tier as a provisional route assessment; only native issuance rows are reviewed below and no unverified bridge controller is scored.
